$\blueD{15\%}$ $\greenD{\text{of}}$ $\maroonD{20}$ is the same as $\blueD{15\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{20}$.

To solve $\blueD{15\%}\greenD{\times}\maroonD{20}$, we need to convert $\blueD{15\%}$ to either a decimal or a fraction.

Percent means per hundred, so $\blueD{15\%}$ is equivalent to $\blueD{\dfrac{15}{100}}$ which is also equal to $\blueD{15\div 100=0.15}$.

 $\blueD{15\%= \dfrac{15}{100} = 0.15}$

$\begin{align}\blueD{15\%}\ \text{of}\ \maroonD{20}&=\blueD{\dfrac{15}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{20}\\\\
&=\blueD{0.15}\cdot\maroonD{20}\\\\
&=3
\end{align}$

Are any of the other choices equivalent?

The fractions $\dfrac{15}{100}$ and $\dfrac{3}{20}$ are equivalent. So:

$\blueD{\dfrac{15}{100}}\cdot\maroonD{20}=\blueD{\dfrac{3}{20}}\cdot\maroonD{20}$

The expression $\blueD{\dfrac{3}{20}}\cdot\maroonD{20}$ is equivalent to $15\%$ of $20$.

$15\cdot 20=300$

The expression $15\cdot 20$ is **not** equivalent to $15\%$ of $20$.

$15\cdot 0.02=0.3$

The expression $15\cdot 0.02$ is **not** equivalent to $15\%$ of $20$.

The options that have the same value as $15\%$ of $20$ are:

- $\dfrac{15}{100}\cdot 20$
- $0.15\cdot 20$
- $\dfrac{3}{20}\cdot 20$
